meta.title: BloogBase – a cozy home for Commander Keen
meta.description: Play the Commander Keen games and the community's mods with one click. Free for Windows, macOS and Linux.
meta.ogAlt: The BloogBase library with covers drawn from each game's title screen
nav.label: Main
hero.title: A cozy home for Commander Keen.
hero.lead: Play the Keen games and close to a hundred community mods with a single click: pick a mod, click Install, click Play. BloogBase deals with ZIPs, patchers and DOSBox settings for you.
hero.facts: Free and open source · Windows, macOS, Linux · English and German

who.title: Made for three kinds of players
who.nostalgic.title: You remember Keen
who.nostalgic.text: from your childhood and have never opened DOSBox. BloogBase sets everything up and gets you to the title screen in minutes.
who.parents.title: You're a parent
who.parents.text: and want your kids to dive into the Keeniverse without an afternoon of setting up. The free episodes are a click away, and saves can't get lost.
who.fans.title: You know every mod
who.fans.text: on KeenWiki. BloogBase keeps them all in one place, each with its own saves, on the right version of the game.
s1.title: Ready on the first start
s1.text: A short setup does what used to take an evening of reading forum threads.
s1.li1: DOSBox Staging, the emulator the games run in, is downloaded, checked and set up for you.
s1.li2: Already own Keen? BloogBase finds your copies from Steam and GOG by itself.
s1.li3: Keen 1, Keen 4 and Keen Dreams were released as shareware: complete games you can play for free. One click installs them, unchanged, from public archives.
s1.li4: It suggests a few mods that run on what you have, so you can try one right away.
s1.note: Every step can be skipped, and the setup can be run again later.
s1.alt: The setup wizard suggesting mods for the games it found
s2.title: Mods with one click
s2.text: For more than thirty years, fans have built new adventures for Keen. Discover lists the best of them, for every game.
s2.li1: Close to a hundred mods with descriptions, authors and links to KeenWiki and the forums. Search, filter by game and type, or start with the recommended ones.
s2.li2: Install downloads the mod from its author's original source, checks it, puts it on the right copy of the game and works out how it starts.
s2.li3: BloogBase takes care of patchers, batch files and missing helper programs behind the scenes; you just press Play.
s2.li4: The list updates itself: new mods and mod updates show up without an app update, and it works offline.
s2.alt: Discover: the mod list with search, filters and recommended mods
s3.title: Any mod from KeenWiki
s3.text: Found a mod that isn't in the list? Paste the link to its KeenWiki page.
s3.li1: BloogBase reads that one page and takes the title, description, authors, release date and credits along.
s3.li2: Pick the version you want; the newest is preselected.
s3.li3: A ZIP or folder of your own works too: drop it on the window. BloogBase tells games from mods, finds out which game a mod is for and how it starts.
s3.li4: Level packs made for another mod are played over that mod automatically.
s3.alt: Adding a mod by pasting its KeenWiki link
s4.title: Your saves are safe
s4.text: Every game and every mod gets its own play profile with its own saves, settings and high scores.
s4.li1: Your original game files are never changed. A save is in its final place the moment the game writes it, so even a crash can't lose it.
s4.li2: Each save shows its name, score, lives, ammo, levels done and difficulty, read from the file itself.
s4.li3: When a session overwrites a save, BloogBase keeps the earlier one, and earlier versions of a save can be brought back.
s4.li4: Back up, restore, export and import. Remove a mod, and its saves wait for you if you ever add it again.
s4.alt: The saves of Keen 6 with their details
s5.title: A fan museum for your collection
s5.text: BloogBase treats every game and mod like an exhibit worth looking at.
s5.li1: Covers are drawn from each game's own title screen, right from the files on your computer: EGA and CGA, mod palettes, even the colours of composite monitors.
s5.li2: Every mod's page credits its authors, links to KeenWiki and the forums, and shows its readme, in old DOS encodings, RTF or Word.
s5.li3: Play time, last played, the screenshots and videos you take in DOSBox, played back right in the app.
s5.li4: And on every start, a made-up Commander Keen fact. Did you know?
s5.alt: A mod's page with its title screen, credits, links and readme
s6.title: Day and night
s6.text: Midnight Galaxy for the night sky over Vorticon VI, Vintage Beige for the case of the PC you first played Keen on. Or let your system decide.
s6.handle: Move between Midnight Galaxy and Vintage Beige

details.title: The details that make it just work
details.text: Behind the one click sits a lot of knowledge about the games and how mods were made over three decades.
details.play.title: Playing
details.play.li1: Optional one-button firing in Keen 1–3: Space shoots instead of Ctrl+Alt, also in mods.
details.play.li2: Fullscreen, a CRT monitor effect and tear-free scrolling as simple switches.
details.play.li3: Keys follow your keyboard layout (Windows), so a German or French keyboard answers “Y” with Y.
details.play.li4: When a game ends with a message on the DOS screen, BloogBase shows it to you.
details.play.li5: The game window carries the game's name, and a loading screen with its cover bridges the wait.
details.games.title: Games and versions
details.games.li1: Knows 42 releases of the seven games by their files: v1.0 to v1.93, EGA and CGA, FormGen, GT Interactive and id Anthology releases.
details.games.li2: Even the betas and demos of 1990 and 1991, installed from public archives.
details.games.li3: Several versions of a game side by side; mods go on the copy they fit best, and you can switch.
details.games.li4: A mod can be installed before its game. It waits and tells you where to get it.
details.mods.title: Mods that just work
details.mods.li1: Finds how a mod starts, even with renamed patchers and batch files that only shuffle files around.
details.mods.li2: Brings what mods leave out: CKPatch, KDrPatch and a DPMI host, unmodified, with their licences.
details.mods.li3: Runs DOSBox as the machine a mod needs: a composite CGA for the Composite CGA editions, an SVGA for 640×480 mods.
details.mods.li4: Checks installed mods for updates in the mod list and on KeenWiki; updating keeps your saves.
details.mods.li5: Opens old and damaged ZIP files that today's tools give up on.
details.dosbox.title: DOSBox, handled
details.dosbox.li1: Downloads a pinned, hash-checked DOSBox Staging for your system, or uses your own.
details.dosbox.li2: Every DOSBox setting stays within reach, as text, for all games or one, with BloogBase's defaults shown beside it.
details.dosbox.li3: Your own DOSBox setup is never touched, and BloogBase's never touches it.
details.care.title: Made with care
details.care.li1: What's new on start: changes in BloogBase, new mods, updates for yours.
details.care.li2: Updates itself, and never while a game is running.
details.care.li3: Keyboard friendly, with screen reader labels; it respects reduced motion.
details.care.li4: No telemetry. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you send it.
details.safe.title: Safe to try
details.safe.li1: App updates and the mod list are signed, and every download from the list is checked against its hash.
details.safe.li2: Mods run in DOSBox's secure mode: they see their own game folder, not the rest of your computer.
details.safe.li3: Archives can't write outside their folder, and oversized downloads are stopped.
details.safe.li4: Readmes are shown as plain text; links open in your browser. More about security.
games.title: Seven games, one home
games.text: Three of them are free. For the others, BloogBase finds your copy from Steam or GOG, or takes it from a folder or ZIP.

dl.title: Download BloogBase
dl.text: Free, for every system. BloogBase is a fan project, so its installers aren't signed with paid certificates. Your system asks once before the first start; after that, BloogBase keeps itself up to date.
dl.windowsHint: If Edge says the file “isn’t commonly downloaded”, click … → Keep → the arrow next to Delete → Keep anyway. If “Windows protected your PC” appears, click More info → Run anyway.
dl.macFile: BloogBase_…_aarch64.dmg (Apple Silicon) or BloogBase_…_x64.dmg (Intel)
dl.macHint: Move BloogBase to Applications and start it. When macOS blocks it, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
dl.linuxFile: BloogBase_…_amd64.AppImage or the .deb for Debian/Ubuntu
dl.linuxHint: Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12 or newer. Make the AppImage executable and start it.
dl.all: All files of the latest release
community.title: Made with the Keen community
community.suggest.title: A mod is missing?
community.suggest.text: Install it from its KeenWiki page, then choose Suggest it for the mod list on its page in BloogBase. Or open an issue with the link.
community.bug.title: Found a bug?
community.bug.text: About → Diagnostics in BloogBase collects what helps, with personal paths taken out, and opens a new issue. Nothing is sent by itself. Security problems please report privately.
community.authors.title: You made a mod?
community.authors.text: Thank you! BloogBase never hosts mods: it downloads them from where you published them and credits you on every page. Tell us if your entry needs fixing, or if you'd rather not have it listed.
community.thanks: Thanks to the mod authors, KeenWiki, the Shikadi ModdingWiki, the PCKF and Keen: Modding forums, and the DOSBox Staging team.

press.facts.title: At a glance
press.facts.whatValue: A launcher for the Commander Keen games and the mods fans have made for them. It sets up the DOS emulator, installs games and mods, and starts them with one click.
press.facts.byValue: transporthummel, a Keen fan. An unofficial fan project.
press.facts.systemsValue: Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Linux
press.facts.priceValue: Free. No ads, no account, no telemetry.
press.facts.gamesValue: Commander Keen 1–6 and Keen Dreams. Keen 1, Keen 4 and Keen Dreams are free shareware episodes that BloogBase installs itself; the others come from Steam, GOG or the player's own copy.
press.facts.modsValue: in the curated list, each downloaded from where its author published it. Any other mod installs from its KeenWiki page or a ZIP file.
press.facts.licenseValue: Open source: the app under MIT, the mod list under CC BY-SA 4.0.
press.texts.title: Texts to copy
press.texts.text: Use them as they are or change them as you like. No credit needed.
press.texts.one: BloogBase is a free launcher that installs and starts the Commander Keen games and close to a hundred fan-made mods with a single click, on Windows, macOS and Linux.
press.texts.short: BloogBase brings Commander Keen to today's computers. The free, open-source launcher sets up the DOS emulator DOSBox Staging, installs the three free shareware episodes and finds copies bought on Steam or GOG. Players pick one of close to a hundred fan-made mods, click Install and Play, and BloogBase takes care of ZIP files, patchers and DOS settings. Every game and mod keeps its own saves.
press.texts.long1: For more than thirty years, fans have been making new levels and whole new episodes for Commander Keen, id Software's platformer series from 1990. Playing them has meant unpacking ZIP files, finding the right version of the game, starting patchers and setting up DOSBox. BloogBase, a free and open-source launcher for Windows, macOS and Linux, does all of that with one click.
press.texts.long2: On its first start, BloogBase downloads DOSBox Staging and the three episodes that were released as free shareware: Keen 1, Keen 4 and Keen Dreams. Copies bought on Steam or GOG are found automatically. A curated list of close to a hundred mods, each downloaded from where its author published it, is a click away; any other mod installs from its KeenWiki page or a ZIP file.
press.texts.long3: Every game and mod gets its own saves, which BloogBase backs up and can restore; the original game files are never changed. The covers in the library are drawn from each game's own title screen. BloogBase is an unofficial fan project, available in English and German.
press.story.title: Why BloogBase exists
press.story.p1: Getting Keen mods to run was always a chore for me. Every new mod meant the same routine: find out which version of the game it needs, unzip it into a copy of the game folder, figure out which BAT file or patch to start, set up DOSBox again. And the saves: copying them out before trying another mod, copying them back afterwards, and now and then losing one because I'd forgotten.
press.story.p2: My kids are what finally got me to do something about it. They wanted to try the mods too, and I wanted them to be able to pick one and play without me sitting next to them juggling ZIP files and batch scripts, and without anyone losing their saves.
press.story.by: transporthummel on how BloogBase came about
press.angles.title: Worth knowing
press.angles.alive.title: The scene is alive
press.angles.alive.text: Fans have been making Keen mods since the early 1990s and still release new ones. KeenWiki and the PCKF forum collect them and the knowledge behind them.
press.angles.free.title: Three games are free
press.angles.free.text: Keen 1, Keen 4 and Keen Dreams were released as shareware: complete episodes anyone may play for free. BloogBase downloads them unchanged from public archives. Keen 2, 3 and 5 are sold on Steam and GOG; Keen 6 isn't sold at the moment.
press.angles.easy.title: No DOS knowledge needed
press.angles.easy.text: BloogBase works out which version of the game a mod needs, how it starts and which helper programs it expects. Players never have to touch a ZIP, BAT or config file.
press.angles.saves.title: Saves stay safe
press.angles.saves.text: Every game and mod has its own saves. BloogBase keeps the earlier version when a save is overwritten, and it never changes the original game files.
press.angles.museum.title: A fan museum
press.angles.museum.text: The covers in the library are drawn from each game's and mod's own title screen, read from the files on the player's computer. Every mod's page credits its authors and links to KeenWiki.
press.angles.open.title: Open and fair
press.angles.open.text: Free, open source and without telemetry. BloogBase hosts no mods: it downloads them from where their authors published them, and takes any entry off the list if its author asks.
press.pictures.title: Logo and screenshots
press.use.text: You may use the logo, the icon and the screenshots in articles, videos and posts about BloogBase.

press.use.credit: The title screens in the screenshots belong to id Software and the mod authors. A credit such as “Screenshot: BloogBase” is welcome but not required.

press.legal.li1: BloogBase contains no game data. The shareware episodes are downloaded unchanged from public archives; the other games come from the player's own copy.
press.legal.li2: Mods are downloaded from their authors' original sources, never from BloogBase. Authors can have their entry changed or removed at any time.
press.legal.li3: Commander Keen is a trademark of id Software. BloogBase is an unofficial fan project and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, ZeniMax Media, Apogee or Softdisk.
press.legal.li4: The installers aren't signed with paid certificates, so Windows and macOS ask once before the first start. The download section shows how to continue.
